candidate_relations.reason: The diffuse infiltration, madarosis, nodules, foamy histiocytes, and numerous acid-fast bacilli support lepromatous leprosy; the benchmark additionally requires T2R, reflected by systemic inflammatory manifestations including polyarthritis, lymphadenopathy, and uveitis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies lepromatous leprosy but omits the concurrent type 2 leprosy reaction (T2R).
